// divguard:path coding/runtime.go

package coding

import "context"

type ToolCallHookResult struct {
	Block  bool
	Reason string
}

type emitResult struct {
	Block  bool
	Reason string
}

type runner interface {
	EmitToolCall(ctx context.Context, name string) (*emitResult, error)
}

// toolCallHook reproduces AGENT-04: a handler that throws lets the tool run.
func toolCallHook(r runner) func(ctx context.Context, name string) ToolCallHookResult {
	return func(ctx context.Context, name string) ToolCallHookResult {
		result, err := r.EmitToolCall(ctx, name)
		if err != nil || result == nil { // want
			return ToolCallHookResult{}
		}
		return ToolCallHookResult{Block: result.Block, Reason: result.Reason}
	}
}
